system.description:
The most cunning and brutal of Orcs learn how to channel their own inner fires to cow their brethren. Brutal Intimidation is a special Intimidation skill, rooted from Hatred. All tests are open-ended.

FoRKs: Torture (when applicable), Interrogation

Skill Type: Social. Tools: No.

Restrictions: Orcs only

Root: Hatred (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Book root includes Hatred, which the system cannot use as a root; Will is used instead.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 262
